articles.title: Burglar Wearing PM Modi Mask Steals Smartphones Worth ₹5 Lakh From Rajasthan Shop
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A burglary at a mobile phone shop in Rajasthan's Bhilwara district has drawn attention after one of the suspects was caught on CCTV wearing a mask resembling Prime Minister Narendra Modi while allegedly carrying out the theft.

body.html:
A burglary at a mobile phone shop in Rajasthan's Bhilwara district has drawn attention after one of the suspects was caught on CCTV wearing a mask resembling Prime Minister Narendra Modi while allegedly carrying out the theft.

The incident took place late on Monday night at Mateshwari Mobile Shop near the bus stand in Kareda town. According to shop owner Laxman Sen, the thieves entered the shop through the rooftop after breaking the lock on the staircase gate and stole around 35 to 40 smartphones worth an estimated ₹4–5 lakh.

The theft came to light on Tuesday morning when Sen opened the shop and found it ransacked, with empty mobile phone boxes and merchandise scattered across the floor.

Police reached the spot after receiving the complaint and examined the crime scene. CCTV footage from the shop and nearby areas allegedly shows one of the suspects wearing a mask resembling Prime Minister Narendra Modi in an apparent attempt to conceal his identity.

Police suspect the same group also attempted to break into another mobile shop, Sanwariya Mobile, near Beej Godam Chowk on the same night. CCTV footage from that location reportedly shows the same masked individual trying to break the shop's shutter lock before fleeing.

A case has been registered, and police have launched a search for the accused using CCTV footage and other available evidence.

articles.title: Speeding Biker Runs Over Child in Akola, Victim Critical in ICU
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A child was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding motorcycle in Maharashtra's Akola district on Tuesday. The shocking incident was captured on CCTV and has sparked outrage over road safety.

body.html:
A child was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding motorcycle in Maharashtra's Akola district on Tuesday. The shocking incident was captured on CCTV and has sparked outrage over road safety.

The CCTV footage shows the child playing on the road when a motorcycle, allegedly travelling at high speed through a residential lane, rammed into the youngster, leaving the child critically injured.

The video further shows nearby residents rushing to help the child immediately after the collision. The motorcyclist also returned to the spot and helped shift the injured child to a hospital.

According to reports, the child, who was lying in a pool of blood on the road, was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU), where the condition remains critical.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident. Further details, including the child's age and the exact location of the accident, are yet to be officially confirmed.

#Akola #Maharashtra #RoadAccident #CCTV #BreakingNews

articles.title: Bigg Boss Kannada Fame Divya Suresh Alleges Harassment on Bengaluru Street, Shares Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kannada actress and Bigg Boss Kannada fame Divya Suresh has alleged that she was harassed by an unidentified man while walking to her car in Bengaluru late on Sunday night. She shared a video of the incident on Instagram and tagged Bengaluru Police, raising concerns over women's safety.

body.html:
Kannada actress and Bigg Boss Kannada fame Divya Suresh has alleged that she was harassed by an unidentified man while walking to her car in Bengaluru late on Sunday night. She shared a video of the incident on Instagram and tagged Bengaluru Police, raising concerns over women's safety.

According to Divya, the incident occurred at around 11:30 pm when she and her cousin were walking towards their parked vehicle. She alleged that an unknown man began following them and behaved inappropriately.

In her Instagram post, Divya said she and her cousin confronted the man after noticing his behaviour, but he allegedly continued following them until they got into their car.

She further claimed that the man remained near the vehicle even after they locked themselves inside. In a video shared by the actress, her cousin is seen pointing towards the man and suggesting that the police be called.

Questioning the safety of women in the city, Divya wrote, "No woman should have to experience this simply because she's walking at night," and tagged Bengaluru Police, asking, "Where is the safety we keep being promised?"

As of now, Bengaluru Police have not issued an official statement regarding the alleged incident.

Divya Suresh is known for her appearance in Bigg Boss Kannada Season 8 and has acted in television serials including Nanna Hendthi MBBS and Jodi Hakki. She is also the winner of the Miss India South 2017 title and has appeared in films such as Rowdy Baby, Kempu Haladi Hasiru and Hiranya.

#Bengaluru #DivyaSuresh #BiggBossKannada #WomenSafety

articles.title: Teacher's Slap Leaves Class 10 Student With Ruptured Eardrum; Suspension Ordered in Ahmedabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A teacher at a private school in Ahmedabad has been suspended after allegedly slapping a Class 10 student so hard that the boy suffered a ruptured eardrum and may require surgery. Police have launched an investigation following a complaint filed by the student's father.

body.html:
A teacher at a private school in Ahmedabad has been suspended after allegedly slapping a Class 10 student so hard that the boy suffered a ruptured eardrum and may require surgery. Police have launched an investigation following a complaint filed by the student's father.

The incident took place at Chanakya School in Ahmedabad's Nikol area during a physical training (PT) session. According to the school management, the student, who is enrolled in the Gujarati-medium section of Class 10, was sitting and talking with friends on the school grounds when an English-medium teacher, identified as Laxman, allegedly approached and slapped him despite having no direct connection with the class.

The student's left ear reportedly became swollen, started bleeding, and he complained of hearing loss. After being informed by the school, the boy's father took him to a doctor, where medical examination reportedly revealed a ruptured eardrum.

Doctors have advised that if the swelling does not subside within a week, the student may have to undergo surgery.

The accused teacher has reportedly admitted his mistake before the school trust and the student's family. However, the student's father has refused to forgive him and has decided to pursue legal action, stating that the school and teacher would be responsible if his son suffers permanent hearing loss.

Following the complaint, Krishnanagar Police registered a non-cognisable (NC) case and detained the teacher for questioning. An investigation is underway.

Ahmedabad District Education Officer Rohit Chaudhary said an inquiry was ordered immediately after the incident came to light, and the teacher was suspended with immediate effect. The school has also suspended the teacher pending the outcome of the investigation.

articles.title: Woman Security Guard Assaulted at Akola Hospital While Trying to Stop Couple's Fight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman security guard on duty at the District Women's Hospital in Akola was allegedly assaulted by the husband of a patient after she intervened in a dispute between the couple inside the hospital premises.

body.html:
A woman security guard on duty at the District Women's Hospital in Akola was allegedly assaulted by the husband of a patient after she intervened in a dispute between the couple inside the hospital premises.

According to reports, an argument broke out between a female patient and her husband. When the security guard stepped in to defuse the situation, the patient's husband, identified as Pradeep Gawande, allegedly assaulted her.

The incident took place near the hospital's NICU, where the security guard was posted on duty.

The alleged assault was captured on the hospital's CCTV cameras. Police are expected to examine the footage and take further action. An investigation is underway.

articles.title: Physiotherapist Found Dead in Nandi Hills Resort; Boyfriend Unconscious, Murder Angle Under Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young physiotherapist was found dead inside a locked resort room near the popular tourist destination of Nandi Hills on Monday morning, while her boyfriend was found unconscious beside her.

body.html:
A young physiotherapist was found dead inside a locked resort room near the popular tourist destination of Nandi Hills on Monday morning, while her boyfriend was found unconscious beside her.

The deceased has been identified as Sai Surabhi, a resident of Banashankari and a physiotherapist at Satya Sai Hospital in Muddenahalli. Her boyfriend, Sanjeeth Ali, an engineer and cab driver from Kozhikode, Kerala, who works in Bengaluru, was found unconscious in the room.

According to police, Ali had checked into a homestay near Muddenahalli, at the foothills of Nandi Hills, on Saturday. It is not yet clear when Surabhi joined him.

The incident came to light on Monday after the couple failed to check out. Despite repeated knocks and phone calls, there was no response from inside the locked room. Resort staff then alerted the police.

After breaking open the door, police found Surabhi dead with a rope tied around her neck. Preliminary findings suggest death due to strangulation or h***ng. Ali was found unconscious beside her.

Police also recovered a diary containing multiple entries and scattered medical pills from the room. He was shifted to a hospital for treatment.

Chikkaballapur Superintendent of Police Kushal Choksi and forensic teams visited the spot and launched an investigation.

Surabhi's mother, Geeta, and her brother, Shankar Narayan, alleged that the case was linked to "Love Jihad". Geeta claimed her daughter had recently joined Satya Sai Hospital and had told the family she would be attending a satsang on Saturday and staying at the hospital that night.

She further alleged that Ali had previously harassed Surabhi and forced her to consume drugs and alcohol. According to the family, Surabhi had undergone rehabilitation after ending the relationship but later came back into contact with him.

Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death, and the exact sequence of events will be determined after the investigation and post-mortem report.

#NandiHills #Karnataka #Chikkaballapur #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: BJP Block Chief Accuses IAS Officer Rinku Singh Rahi of Assault During Cold Storage Inspection
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh IAS officer and Joint Magistrate Rinku Singh Rahi has landed in fresh controversy after BJP Block Pramukh Ramraja Niranjan accused him of assault during an inspection in Jalaun. A video of the incident has surfaced, and the District Magistrate has ordered an inquiry.

body.html:
Uttar Pradesh IAS officer and Joint Magistrate Rinku Singh Rahi has landed in fresh controversy after BJP Block Pramukh Ramraja Niranjan accused him of assault during an inspection in Jalaun. A video of the incident has surfaced, and the District Magistrate has ordered an inquiry.

The incident took place on June 23 when Joint Magistrate Rinku Singh Rahi visited a cold storage in Betwa, owned by Ramraja Niranjan, to inspect safety standards.

According to Ramraja Niranjan, his manager was cooperating with the inspection but was unable to produce all the required documents within the time given as the cold storage director was away with the records. He alleged that when he reached the spot, Rinku Singh Rahi slapped his mobile phone, causing it to fall to the ground, and later pushed him during an argument.

The viral video shows Rinku Singh Rahi knocking the mobile phone out of Ramraja Niranjan's hand and pushing him back with both hands after the two came face-to-face.

Following the complaint, Jalaun District Magistrate Rajesh Kumar Pandey constituted a five-member committee to investigate the allegations.

Rinku Singh Rahi has previously been in controversy. In 2025, while serving as SDM in Shahjahanpur, he made a court clerk perform sit-ups over alleged misconduct, after which he himself performed sit-ups in front of protesting lawyers. Following the controversy, he was attached to the Revenue Council headquarters in Lucknow. In May 2026, he was posted to Jalaun.

Rinku Singh Rahi is known for exposing a major scholarship scam during his tenure as District Social Welfare Officer in Muzaffarnagar. In 2009, he survived a gun attack in which he was hit by seven bullets while probing the alleged scam.

The inquiry into the latest incident is underway.

#UttarPradesh #Jalaun #IAS #RinkuSinghRahi #ViralVideo #BJP

articles.title: Heart Attack' Claim Unravels: Mysuru Woman Arrested for Allegedly Strangling Husband to Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman has been arrested for allegedly murdering her husband and attempting to pass off his death as a heart attack in Mysuru. The deceased has been identified as Nityananda (50), an employee of a private company and a resident of the HUDCO Layout in Kuvempunagar, Mysuru.

body.html:
A woman has been arrested for allegedly murdering her husband and attempting to pass off his death as a heart attack in Mysuru.

The deceased has been identified as Nityananda (50), an employee of a private company and a resident of the HUDCO Layout in Kuvempunagar, Mysuru. His wife, Susheela, a teacher at a private school, has been arrested in connection with the case.

According to police, the couple had been married for 10 years and did not have children. They allegedly had frequent disputes over financial and property-related issues.

Police said Nityananda returned home drunk on Sunday night and went to sleep. Susheela allegedly strangled him to death using a rope while he was asleep.

When Nityananda did not respond to phone calls, his friend Darshan visited the house and found him dead. Susheela then informed Nityananda's brother that he had suffered a cardiac arrest.

However, while preparations for the funeral were underway, Nityananda's brother noticed injury marks on his neck and alerted the police. During the investigation, Susheela allegedly confessed to the crime, police said.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

#Mysuru #Karnataka #MurderCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Woman Tries to Swap Gold Ring With Fake One at Nashik Jewellery Shop, Staff Foil Theft Bid
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman allegedly attempted to steal a gold ring by swapping it with a counterfeit one at a jewellery shop in the CIDCO area of Nashik. The alleged theft attempt was foiled by the alertness of the shop staff, and the entire incident was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A woman allegedly attempted to steal a gold ring by swapping it with a counterfeit one at a jewellery shop in the CIDCO area of Nashik. The alleged theft attempt was foiled by the alertness of the shop staff, and the entire incident was captured on CCTV.

According to shop officials, the woman entered the jewellery store posing as a customer and asked to examine gold rings.

While interacting with the staff, she allegedly tried to replace a genuine gold ring with a fake one in an apparent attempt to leave the shop without paying for the original ornament.

However, vigilant employees noticed the suspected swap in time and prevented the alleged theft before the woman could leave the premises.

The entire incident was recorded on the shop's CCTV cameras, and the footage is expected to aid the investigation.

Police are likely to examine the CCTV footage and take further action based on the complaint lodged by the jewellery shop.

An investigation is underway to ascertain the woman's identity and determine whether she may have been involved in similar incidents elsewhere.

#Nashik #Maharashtra #JewelleryShop #GoldRing #CCTV

articles.title: Man Slaps, Kicks and Hits Security Guard With Slipper Over Visitor Entry at Dwarka Society
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man allegedly assaulted a security guard by hitting him with a slipper, kicking and punching him at a residential society in Dwarka Sector 18A on Thursday. A CCTV video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

body.html:
A man allegedly assaulted a security guard by hitting him with a slipper, kicking and punching him at a residential society in Dwarka Sector 18A on Thursday. A CCTV video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

According to police, the accused is a resident of Vijayee Veer Awas Yojna (Kargil Flats), while the victim, Manoj, was posted as a security guard at Gate No. 1 of the society.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (Dwarka) Kushal Pal Singh said a written complaint was received from Ajit Singh Nandal, president of the Residents' Welfare Association (RWA), alleging that resident Tarun Kumar assaulted the security guard.

Police said the incident took place at around 11.22 am when the accused allegedly objected to the security protocol requiring visitors to make an entry in the register. He then allegedly assaulted the guard, wrongfully confined him, and created panic in the society.

The injured guard was sent for medical examination to determine the nature of his injuries.

Based on the complaint, CCTV footage and other available evidence, Dwarka North Police registered an FIR against Tarun Kumar under Sections 115 (voluntarily causing hurt), 127 (wrongful confinement), 351 (criminal intimidation), and 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Police said the accused has not been arrested so far. A notice has been issued directing him to join the investigation. Further investigation is underway.

#Delhi #Dwarka #ViralVideo #SecurityGuard #CCTV
